newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber closes higher amid local short covering.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber closes higher amid local short covering.

text.p: CME lumber futures closed higher, boosted by talk that the market may be bottoming out after its recent slide to contract lows.
Dealers noted active bull spreading, with September's premium to November widening to around $3.80 from about $1.60 indicated at the close on Wednesday.
Locals were also covering shorts in October.
September lumber closed up $6.10 per thousand board feet at $345.50 with other months $3.90 to $5.40 higher. The first month had set a contract low of $339.20 per tbf on Wednesday.
